fields.label: Title
fields.description: Names the rule, for example Sales Order to Delivery Note.

fields.label: Action Label
fields.description: The button the task shows, in English, for example Create Delivery Note.

fields.label: Source DocType
fields.description: The document that is done. A task is made for each document of this DocType.

fields.label: Due Date Field
fields.description: Field of the source document that holds the due date (optional).

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: An expression on doc, for example doc.docstatus == 1 and doc.per_delivered < 100. The task stays open while it is true and closes by itself when it is false.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The document the team makes next. Only users who may create it get the task.

fields.label: Make Method
fields.description: Whitelisted mapper taking source_name (used by open_mapped_doc), for example erpnext.selling.doctype.sales_order.sales_order.make_delivery_note.

fields.label: Who
fields.description: Roles name the team; Department and Designation narrow it. If the narrowing leaves nobody, every holder of a role gets the task. Never a named user.

fields.label: Department Field
fields.description: Field of the source document that holds a Department; the user's Employee must belong to that Department.

fields.label: Hand-off Step
fields.description: Id of the hand-off step in the Approval Step catalog, for example ho_qt_so. A rule made on a site may leave it empty and is then named by its title.
